result.topic_en: Riemann transforms the general integral $\int (z-a)^\alpha (z-b)^\beta (z-c)^\gamma (z-d)^\delta dz$ into the hypergeometric integral $\int_0^1 y^\alpha(1-y)^\beta(1-xy)^\gamma dy$ by a linear fractional substitution, computing the resulting constant factors and the cross-ratio $x$.

methods.what: Linear fractional substitution sending a,b,c,d to 0,1,1/x,∞ to reduce the four-point integral to the Euler hypergeometric integral
Transformed factors 1-y, 1-xy and the differential dy
Resulting integral identity with constant factor
Symmetric normalization factor with exponents (sum of two exponents +1)/2 over pairwise differences
